entity_crosscheck.interpretation: Entity stake is approximate: net_share (24h evaluation window) × network effective balance at the returned end epoch. Event flows and standing stake have different time bases; comparisons are context checks, not equality tests.

deposits.fields: amount, type, status, deposit_validity, withdrawal_credentials, validator, request, stage_history
deposits.rule: One cursor-paginated query per slot 14518799–15407743. Keep completed, valid deposit/top_up records. Sum amount in wei; one record is one event. Shared by every deposit metric, daily chart and entity ranking.
deposits.example_origin: Actual saved request for this dataset

metadata.rule: Send up to 100 identifiers together; follow ten-row cursor pages. Join by validator, preserve Unknown. Present-day provider attribution; not historical ownership.
metadata.example_origin: Actual saved request for this dataset

registry.rule: Batch up to 100 comma-separated validators. Registry credentials plus successful switch/BLS history reconstruct the recipient credential when a top-up was processed.
registry.example_origin: Actual saved request for this dataset

switches.rule: Successful switch after the deposit processing slot means the validator was still 0x01 then. A switch never transfers ETH between validators.
switches.example_origin: Actual saved request for this dataset

bls.rule: Batch up to 100. A BLS change after the event means its earlier recipient credential was 0x00.
bls.example_origin: Actual saved request for this dataset

requests.fields: type, status, amount, source_validator, target_validator, request, stage_history
requests.rule: One cursor-paginated query per inclusion slot. Separate consolidation from compounding_switch; sum only completed consolidation amount. Outcomes are as last observed, even if processed later.
requests.example_origin: Actual saved request for this dataset

balances.rule: Up to 100 validators per batch per reference epoch E. V1 reports end-of-epoch: request E−1 to match the beginning of E. Multiply gwei by 10^9. Daily charts include only cohort validators active at E. Switch amounts use effective balance at the start of the switch epoch, at most 6.4 minutes before the switch.
balances.example_origin: Actual saved request for this dataset

balance_check.rule: Sample V2 wei balances at E are compared with V1 at E−1. Ten sampled validators matched in the pilot.
balance_check.example_origin: Actual saved request for this dataset

network.rule: One call per daily reference epoch, reused by network totals. This is the full-network overview and is independent of the event cohort.
network.example_origin: Actual saved request for this dataset

entity_network.rule: Network effective stake at the entity directory evaluation end epoch. Shared once across all entity-scale checks; this reference can be later than the deposit reporting window.
entity_network.example_origin: Actual saved request for this dataset

entities.fields: entity, validator_count, net_share; last_updated and returned range
entities.rule: Bounded top-2500 directory snapshot by network share. Share is a decimal fraction. Multiply by network effective ETH at the returned end epoch for an approximate standing-stake benchmark; this is a different quantity and time basis from three-day deposit flow. Unmatched names remain explicit.
entities.example_origin: Actual saved request for this dataset

submissions.fields: block_ts, publickey, withdrawal_credentials, amount, tx_hash, merkletree_index, removed
submissions.rule: Batch up to 100. Select [start,end) using block_ts, exclude removed logs, deduplicate tx_hash + merkletree_index + publickey. Original prefix is retained: submission-date ranking covers only scanned validators.
submissions.example_origin: Actual saved request for this dataset

coverage.rule: Fallback evidence for failed slot details. Overview includes system events, so missing details are never filled with zero or added to external deposit totals.
coverage.example_origin: Actual saved request for this dataset
